note: SYNTHETIC. Fictional telco 'Meridian Mobile' — not a real company. No real customer data.

ground_truth.earliest_intervention_action: On contact 1 the agent hit their approval ceiling and should have handed the case to someone who could approve it, instead of promising to 'see what I can do' and leaving it with themselves
ground_truth.why_this_scenario_exists: 根因是「权限不足」：客服本人认同应该退，但金额超过他的审批额度，而他没有上报，只是承诺'我看看能不能办'。三通电话后依然卡在同一个人手里。用来测系统能否识别「同一个人反复承诺但无权兑现」这种模式——它和「无人负责」不同，这里有人负责，只是那个人办不了。

contacts.summary: Customer disputes $410 of excess data charges after a plan change went through late. Agent agrees it looks wrong but the amount exceeds what they can approve.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: I changed to the bigger plan on the second, but the excess data charges from before that are still on here. Four hundred and ten dollars.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Looking at it, I'd agree with you — the plan change should have taken effect before that billing period closed.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: So you can take it off?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Anything over two hundred I can't action myself. Let me see what I can do and come back to you.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: How long does that usually take?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I'll come back to you within three working days.

contacts.summary: A week later, still nothing. Same agent, same ceiling, another promise to try.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: It's been a week. Nobody's come back about the four hundred and ten.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I'm sorry, I've been chasing it. It's still sitting with me because of the approval limit.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Is there someone who can just approve it?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I'll try to get it looked at this week.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: That's what I was told last time.
